title: Whether the theology of wayfarers can be called speculative from the speculation or vision that will be in the homeland
pass_a_gloss: Article XXIX. Whether the theology of wayfarers can be called speculative from the speculation or vision that will be in the homeland. 1. Some call the theology of the way speculative from its end — the vision of God in the homeland. But this confuses the theology of the way with the theology of the homeland. 2. We answer: wayfarers' theology is not speculative from the future vision as from its present form; for the present form is faith, not vision. It can be said to be ordered to the homeland's speculation as to an end; but it is not on that account merely speculative in the way.
pass_b_english: Article XXIX. Whether the theology of wayfarers can be called speculative from the speculation or vision that will be in the homeland.
1. Some call way-theology speculative from its end — God's vision in the homeland. That confuses way-theology with homeland theology.

2. Wayfarers' theology is not speculative from future vision as its present form — the present form is faith, not vision. It is ordered to homeland speculation as end; it is not merely speculative in the way.
source_text:
ART. XXIX.
An Theologia Viatorum dici possit speculativa a speculatione, seu visione, qua futura est in patria.

1. Quidam Theologiam viae speculativam dicunt a fine — visione DEI in patria. Sed hoc confundit Theologiam viae cum Theologia patriae.

2. Respondemus: Theologia viatorum non est speculativa a visione futura tanquam a forma sua praesenti; nam forma praesens est fides, non visio. Dici potest ordinari ad speculationem patriae ut ad finem; sed non inde mere speculativa in via.
